findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed the handwashing sink in the shared back stock(deli & bakery) area to not have soap in the dispenser. Discussed with PIC and soap was replaced. Ensure that hand-sinks are always supplied with hand soap in order to properly wash hands. 

6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Observed a few gallons of 1% milk to exceed the manufacturer's use-by-date of 5/13/2024. Discussed with PIC and milks were pulled and discarded. PIC mentioned that the milks aren't used often. Ensure that milks are never kept past the manufacturer’s use-by-date. 

3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.citation_text:
3-304.11 Fan at cake decorating area was observed with dust accumulation, and a few pieces of dust were loose/blowing from the front service. Fan was facing direction were employee wash currently decorating a cake. Fan was repositioned to eliminate risk of dust blowing on cakes while being decorated. Ensure fan is cleaned as needed to eliminate buildup of dust, especially if it will be blowing toward area where food prep/handling are in progress.
Food shall only contact equipment and utensils that are cleaned and sanitized as specified in Parts 4-6 and 4-7 of this Code; single-service and single-use articles; and linens, such as cloth napkins, as specified under § 3 304.13 that are laundered as specified under Part 4-8 of this Code.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114 Quat solutions in sani-buckets at cake decorating and bakery areas were observed at 100ppm. Fresh solutions at 200ppm were provided. Provide fresh solution as needed throughout daily operations. Ensure use of quat test strips to verify sanitizer is at proper concentration when dispensed for use. 
A quaternary ammonia compound solution shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions and be maintained at the concentration as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. Ensure product is maintained at 150-400ppm as required per product label directions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 Floor and wall were soiled with general buildup of splash under the bakery 3 part sink. Ensure cleaning of floors and walls under sinks and other equipment as needed to eliminate buildup. 
Physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11  (Pf) Observed a spray bottle inside of the hand sink next to the 3 compartment sink. Spray bottle was removed during the inspection. Hand washing sinks must be accessible at all times. Reference 5-205.11.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Soil residue present on the sprayer of the 3 compartment sink and containers where baking supplies are stored. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Observed several powders in the artisan baking area that are removed from the bulk containers and contents are not labeled. Label all powders removed from bulk containers as to their contents.
750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed potentially hazardous foods in walk in cooler (shared with deli) to be holding 46-52F. Thermometer in unit read 48F upon initial entry. General manger states that unit is most likely in an hour defrost process, but unit remained at this temperature throughout inspection. GM temperature logs for this unit read 46-48F last night. At 3AM this morning, GM temperature log for this unit read 40F. All potentially hazardous foods were probed with recently calibrated (calibrated during inspection as well to ensure accuracy) digital stem thermometers. See order of destruction for items discarded. Deli manager checked unit temperature after inspectors had been out of the unit for half an hour and unit temperature was not declining. GM has placed a service call for the unit and will call SCDPH when unit is fixed. Do not store PHF in unit until SCDPH gives approval to do so. 
750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
1) CORRECTED> Observed sprinkles being stored in cake toppers and stacked on top of one another. Protect sprinkles from potential contamination by not storing these stacked. Lid each container separately. 2) A soiled scoop was stored in the struesel powder bin. Scoop was removed for cleaning. 
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1) REPEAT> Observed the inside of the proofer to be rusting. Remove rust. 2) Seals on proofer are broken and separating from door. Replace seals. 
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed a wet wiping cloth on the counter in the artisan baking area. Store wet wiping cloths in sanitizing solution in between uses.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed the bread slicer to be soiled. 2) CORRECTED> Observed a soiled sifter to be stored in a soiled container of flour. Wash, rinse and sanitizer food contact surfaces.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed char accumulation on the wheeled baking units. Manager states she will have these power washed to remove build up. 2) CORRECTED> The bottom portions of the cake decorating stands are soiled with icing accumulation. Stands were washed, rinsed and sanitized during inspection. Wash, rinse and sanitize every 4 hours. 3) Bread racks have debris accumulation. Clean the bread racks. 4) Plastic cart in bakery is soiled. Clean the cart. 5) CORRECTED> Microwave interior is soiled with food splash. Microwave was cleaned during inspection. 6) CORRECTED> Containers holding measuring spoons are soiled. Containers and utensils inside were removed and washed, rinsed, and sanitized during inspection. 7) CORRECTED> Surfaces of mixer stand are soiled with accumulation. Mixer was cleaned during inspection. 
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed the hand sink closest to the artisan baking area to be slow draining. Maintain plumbing in good repair.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the floors to be soiled in the following areas:) 1) CORRECTED> Under the rack near the oven and around the mixer. 2) Under the rubber mat at the cake decorating station. Clean the floors and mats.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed the corner behind the mixer to have mold accumulation on the wall. Clean the wall. 2) Observed the ceiling tiles above the phone/pizza oven to have dust accumulation. Clean the walls and ceilings.
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.
